A cylindrical tin is $15 \mathrm{~cm}$ high. The circumference of the base circle is $30 \mathrm{~cm}$. An ant walks from point $A$ at the base to point $B$ at the top. Its path is partly vertically upwards and partly along horizontal circular arcs. Its path is drawn in bold on the diagram (with a solid line on the front and a dashed line at the back). How long is the total distance covered by the ant? <image1>
Choices:
A:$45 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$55 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$60 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$65 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$75 \mathrm{~cm}$
question:
A cylinder is $15 \mathrm{~cm}$ high, and its base circumference is $30 \mathrm{~cm}$. A path from point $A$ at the base to point $B$ at the top consists of vertical upward segments and horizontal circular arcs. It is shown in bold, with a solid line on the front and a dashed line at the back. What is the total length of the path? <image1>
Choices:
A:$45 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$55 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$60 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$65 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$75 \mathrm{~cm}$
